title: Distribution agreement terminated early
description: We were Glen Corran's exclusive UK distributor. The agreement needs six months' notice to terminate. On 1 October 2025 they gave us two weeks' notice and appointed a new distributor from 15 October. We think we have lost roughly six months of margin, but our accountant has not yet calculated it.
notes: Breach is clear; loss is asserted but not quantified, so loss should be weak.
